subject.title: Anthropic rejects when multiple tool_result are split across separate messages

question: Should this ClawHub issue be routed or transferred to the OpenClaw runtime/provider tracker, or intentionally kept here as a cross-repository visibility placeholder?
rationale: The report is actionable, but the affected Anthropic transcript serializer is not present in this repository, so automation cannot choose the owning tracker or verify the runtime fix from ClawHub source alone.

options.title: Route To Runtime Tracker
options.body: Move or mirror the report to the OpenClaw runtime/provider issue tracker where the Anthropic transcript serializer can be fixed and tested.

options.title: Keep As Visibility Placeholder
options.body: Leave this issue open in ClawHub only if maintainers want this repository to track cross-repository provider/runtime bugs until the owning tracker is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Route To Runtime Tracker
recommendation.body: Move or mirror the report to the OpenClaw runtime/provider issue tracker where the Anthropic transcript serializer can be fixed and tested.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the best available routing owner from current ClawHub history because the closest provider/package catalog and project-scope files point there while the runtime serializer is absent.
